title: Avicena, which links AI chips with microLEDs instead of lasers, raised a $100M+ Series C led by Intervest, with participation from SK Hynix, Samsung, and AMD
html:
Thariq Shihipar joins OpenAI after leaving Anthropic in October, saying he felt he could “personally contribute the most” to bringing AI to the world at OpenAI  —  I've joined OpenAI! I'm very proud of my time at Anthropic, and I'll continue to root for my former colleagues. Both companies have important roles to play in the future. There is a tremendous amount of work ahead of us to bring AI to the world, and it will demand the very best of a...
